AdminCantBeZeroAddressException().notice: Thrown when trying to set zero address as a queue or veto admin

BatchAlreadyStartedException().notice: Thrown when trying to initiate a batch more than once in a block

CallerMustNotBeContractException().notice: Thrown when trying to execute a trasaction or a batch from the contract when it's forbidden

CallerNotBatchInitiatorException().notice: Thrown when a queue admin tries to add transactions to the batch not initiated by themselves

CallerNotQueueAdminException().notice: Thrown when an account that is not a queue admin tries to queue a transaction or initiate a batch

CallerNotTimelockException().notice: Thrown when an account that is not the timelock contract tries to configure the governor

CallerNotVetoAdminException().notice: Thrown when an account that is not the veto admin tries to cancel a transaction or a batch

CantPerformActionOutsideBatchException().notice: Thrown when trying to execute or cancel a transaction individually while it's part of some batch

CantRemoveLastQueueAdminException().notice: Thrown when trying to remove the last queue admin

ETAMistmatchException().notice: Thrown when batched transaction's ETA differs from the batch ETA

IncorrectBatchException().notice: Thrown when a passed list of transactions doesn't represent a valid queued batch

TransactionAlreadyQueuedException().notice: Thrown when trying to queue a transaction that is already queued

UnexpectedTransactionException(bytes32).notice: Thrown when a passed list of transactions contains a transaction different from those in the queued batch

AddQueueAdmin(address).notice: Emitted when `admin` is added to the list of queue admins

AllowExecutionByContracts().notice: Emitted when transaction/batch execution by contracts is allowed

CancelBatch(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when `caller` cancels a batch initiated in `batchBlock`

ExecuteBatch(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when `caller` executes a batch initiated in `batchBlock`

ForbidExecutionByContracts().notice: Emitted when transaction/batch execution by contracts is forbidden

QueueBatch(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when `caller` initiates a batch in `batchBlock`

RemoveQueueAdmin(address).notice: Emitted when `admin` is removed from the list of queue admins

UpdateVetoAdmin(address).notice: Emitted when `admin` is set as the new veto admin

addQueueAdmin(address).notice: Adds `admin` to the list of queue admins, ensures that it's not zero address

allowExecutionByContracts().notice: Allows transactions/batches to be executed by contracts

batchInfo(uint256).notice: Returns info for the batch initiated in `batchBlock`

batchedTxInfo(bytes32).notice: Returns batch info for the transaction with given `txHash`

cancelBatch((address,uint256,string,byte.notice: Cancels a queued batch of transactions. Ensures that `txs` is the same ordered list of transactions as         the one that was queued, and forwards all calls to the timelock contract.

cancelTransaction(address,uint256,string.notice: Cancels a queued transaction. Ensures that it is not part of any batch and forwards the call to the         timelock contract.

executeBatch((address,uint256,string,byt.notice: Executes a queued batch of transactions. Ensures that `txs` is the same ordered list of transactions as         the one that was queued, and forwards all calls to the timelock contract.

executeTransaction(address,uint256,strin.notice: Executes a queued transaction. Ensures that it is not part of any batch and forwards the call to the         timelock contract.

forbidExecutionByContracts().notice: Forbids transactions/batches to be executed by contracts

isExecutionByContractsAllowed().notice: Whether transaction/batch execution by contracts is allowed

queueAdmins().notice: Returns an array of addresses of queue admins

queueTransaction(address,uint256,string,.notice: Queues a transaction in the timelock. Ensures that it's not already queued. When no batch is initiated,         simply forwards the call to the timelock contract. Otherwise, appends the transaction to the batch after         checking that caller is the account that initiated the batch and ETAs of all transactions are the same.

removeQueueAdmin(address).notice: Removes `admin` from the list of queue admins, ensures that it's not the last admin

startBatch(uint80).notice: Initiates a batch of transactions. All the transactions that are queued after this call in the same block         will form a batch that can only be executed/cancelled as a whole. Typically, this will be the first call         in a multicall that queues a batch, followed by multiple `queueTransaction` calls.

timeLock().notice: Returns an address of the timelock contract

updateVetoAdmin(address).notice: Sets `admin` as the new veto admin, ensures that it's not zero address

vetoAdmin().notice: Returns an address of the veto admin

userdoc.notice: Extends Uniswap's timelock contract with batch queueing/execution and reworked permissions model where,         instead of a single admin to perform all actions, there are multiple queue admins, a single veto admin,         and permissionless execution (which can optionally be restricted to non-contract accounts to prevent         unintended execution of governance proposals inside protocol functions)
